name: Perdon Trend: The Perfect AI Photo of You, Then "Perdón"
blurb: The perdon trend is the TikTok AI vs reality photo trend: first a perfect AI photo of you ("esta soy yo"), then the real photo with the word "perdón" (sorry).

prompts.text: Use the uploaded image as the base. Make the perfect, idealized AI version of this exact photo, the "this is me" first slide of an AI vs reality photo post: the same person, the same pose, the same moment and the same camera angle, but everything a little too perfect. Upgrade only these things, like an AI photo edit that went a little too far: the place becomes the dream version of where the photo was taken (a plain room becomes a bright luxury living room with marble, fresh white flowers and warm lamps; a local court, field or gym becomes a big modern stadium full of cheering fans under bright lights; a street becomes a stylish city street at golden hour; a beach becomes a perfect sunny beach with turquoise water; a kitchen or dining table becomes an elegant restaurant table); the light becomes soft, warm, flattering photo-shoot light with a gently blurred background; the image is sharp, clean and polished, like a professional photographer's shot. The hair is freshly styled at a salon, glossy and neat, in its own color and its own length. The clothes become a clean, ironed, stylish version of the same outfit in the same colors. The skin looks rested and fresh; if the photo shows makeup, it is neat. The expression stays the same, relaxed and photogenic. Keep the body shape and body size exactly as in the photo: never slimmer, curvier, taller or more muscular. Keep the age. Exactly one person: nobody added, nobody removed; a pet in the photo stays, groomed and fluffy. Any logo, crest, brand name or writing on the clothes or in the place becomes plain. Vertical 9:16; if the photo is wider, extend the dream place naturally. Photorealistic, so people believe it for a second. No text, no captions, no stickers, no logos, no watermark, no frame.
